title: nan
authors: Zhao X.; Su B.; Guang X.
key_contribution: Presents a multi-modality fusion global localization method for UGVs in rough terrain GNSS-denied environments using VO, LiDAR odometry, dead reckoning, and road network detection, validated in field navigation.
problem_solved: Addressing state estimation drift in GNSS-denied navigation.
methodology_summary: Fuses sensor data using LiDAR_SLAM to ensure precise positioning.
